playstyle: Five swift Kurnothi hunters built for speed over resilience, with Move 4–5 across the board but health of only 2–4 and mostly single-dodge saves. Their mobility lets them harry opponents and control the board, backed by ranged options on Skaeth and Althaen. The generic Order warscroll offers two paths: inspire by holding treasure tokens in enemy territory, or inspire fighters that strike from friendly ground. Either way, the Hunt wins by outmanoeuvring foes, isolating targets and pressing its speed advantage rather than trading blows.
